title: Medical device importer in New York City
assumptions: A new New York LLC imports medical devices from its parent's factory abroad as initial importer, from an office in Flushing, and hires staff.

items.name: Articles of Organization (New York LLC)
items.agency: New York Department of State, Division of Corporations
items.quote: Organizers form an LLC by filing the Articles of Organization

items.name: Application for Employer Identification Number (EIN)
items.quote: You never have to pay a fee for an EIN.

items.name: LLC publication within 120 days
items.agency: New York Department of State, Division of Corporations
items.quote: Failure to publish and file the Certificate of Publication with the Department of State within 120 days

items.name: Create/Update Importer Identity Form
items.quote: shall file CBP Form 5106 with the first formal entry.

items.name: Customs Bond
items.quote: unless a single entry or continuous bond on Customs Form 301, containing the bond conditions set forth in § 113.62 of this chapter,

items.name: ACE Secure Data Portal account for importers
items.quote: register an entity as an Importer of Record (IOR) in the Automated Commercial Environment (ACE)
items.match: \bcbp-ace\b|ace secure data portal account for importers

items.name: Application for Registration as a Sales Tax Vendor (Certificate of Authority)
items.agency: New York State Department of Taxation and Finance
items.quote: If you must register to collect sales tax and need information about how to register, see Tax Bulletin
items.match: \bny-dtf-17\b|application for registration as a sales tax vendor \(certificate of authority\)
items.agencyMatch: New York State Department of Taxation and Finance

items.name: Medical device establishment registration (initial importer)
items.agency: U.S. Food and Drug Administration, Center for Devices and Radiological Health
items.quote: intended for use in the U.S. are required to register annually with the FDA.

items.name: New employer registration for unemployment insurance and withholding
items.agency: New York State Department of Labor
items.quote: You must complete an employer registration form for us to decide if you are liable under the New York State Unemployment Insurance Law.
items.match: \bny-dol-100\b|new employer registration for unemployment insurance and withholding
items.agencyMatch: New York State Department of Labor

items.name: Proof of workers' comp and disability/paid family leave insurance
items.agency: New York State Workers' Compensation Board
items.quote: Disability and Paid Family Leave benefits coverage is required for sole proprietorships with employees, including part-time employees
items.match: \bny-wcb\b|proof of workers' comp and disability/paid family leave insurance
items.agencyMatch: New York State Workers' Compensation Board

mustNotInclude.name: Any food permit, food handler or plan review
CPSC product certificate
mustNotInclude.why: The Consumer Product Safety Act's "consumer product" excludes devices as the FD&C Act defines them (15 U.S.C. 2052(a)(5)(H)).

facts.quote: The initial importer must have a physical address in the United States staffed by individuals responsible for ensuring the compliance of imported devices
